edges.reason: fundsWallet and premined balance are assigned from msg.sender in the constructor, making the deployer the privileged holder.
balanceOf is keyed by msg.sender throughout transfers, burns and staking, so the caller controls which balance is mutated.
transfer moves tokens belonging to msg.sender without further authorization.
transferFrom uses msg.sender as the allowance owner in allowance[_from][msg.sender].
approve writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender], caller-determined authorization.
approveAndCall forwards msg.sender into the external receiveApproval callback.
burn destroys balanceOf[msg.sender] and reduces totalSupply.
burnFrom consumes allowance[_from][msg.sender], caller-dependent.
addressHashs converts the caller address into the check-point identifier used for reward bookkeeping.
stakerStatus is queried for msg.sender to gate mining and reward functions.
stakerAmount exposes the staked amount of an arbitrary queried address.
necessarySignForReward requires stakerStatus(msg.sender) and writes caller-specific stake data.
rewardGet computes payout from nStockDetails[msg.sender] and transfers to msg.sender.
startMining records nStockDetails[msg.sender] and pushes the caller onto totalminers.
tokenPayBack returns the stake of the calling address based on its own stake record.
sendMemoToken attributes the memo sender to msg.sender and transfers the caller's tokens.
sendMemoOnly attributes the memo sender to msg.sender.
now controls the 1800s round advance and the stake expiry check in necessarySignForReward.
now gates the stake lock condition in rewardGet, making reward timing timestamp dependent.
startMining stores now as _stocktime, so staking start is timestamp dependent.
tokenPayBack requires _stocktime + nWtime < now, a strictly timestamp-driven unlock.
now is stored as the memo receive time in sendMemoToken.
transferFrom reads and decrements allowance[_from][msg.sender] before transferring.
approve overwrites allowance[msg.sender][_spender] with a caller-supplied value.
burnFrom consumes and reduces the spender allowance.
_transfer reads balanceOf[_from] and balanceOf[_to] into unchecked arithmetic.
_transfer writes updated balances back into the balanceOf mapping.
transfer delegates execution to the internal _transfer routine.
transferFrom delegates execution to _transfer after the allowance check.
approveAndCall calls the internal/public approve function before the external callback.
approveAndCall invokes the external tokenRecipient, enabling state-inconsistent reentrant calls.
The external receiveApproval callback can re-enter transferFrom while the approval state is being relied upon.
The external receiveApproval callback can re-enter the public transfer function.
rewardGet performs the payout through the internal _transfer from the contract balance.
startMining locks funds by calling _transfer into the contract address.
tokenPayBack returns stake via _transfer from the contract address.
sendMemoToken performs the token movement through _transfer.
sendMemoOnly performs a zero-value _transfer.
generalCheckPoint builds the checkpoint key from addressHashs(msg.sender).
generalCheckPoint stringifies lastBlock using uintToString.
The constructor establishes the initial balanceOf entries for the deployer and the contract.
_transfer executes balanceOf[_from] -= _value without SafeMath or an overflow guard beyond the pre-require.
_transfer executes balanceOf[_to] += _value with an overflow check expressed only as a pre-condition.
burn executes balanceOf[msg.sender] -= _value unchecked.
burn executes totalSupply -= _value unchecked, allowing supply underflow if invariants break.
burnFrom executes balanceOf[_from] -= _value unchecked.
burnFrom executes allowance[_from][msg.sender] -= _value unchecked.
startMining computes mineamount * 10**decimals and adds it to maximumTarget without overflow protection.
rewardGet pays the computed usersReward out of the contract's own token balance.
necessarySignForReward requires blockhash(_bnumber) % nRewarMod == 1, a miner-influenceable predicate.
rewardGet requires the same blockhash predicate before paying out the reward.
burn mutates totalSupply via unchecked subtraction.
burnFrom mutates totalSupply via unchecked subtraction.
startMining accumulates maximumTarget with a user-supplied, unchecked scaled amount.
A signed round (necessarySignForReward) must precede reward collection in rewardGet.
necessarySignForReward uses the generalCheckPoint key to write reward details.
rewardGet uses the generalCheckPoint key to read and update reward details.
